text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The race result was more than passing grade.
It was a passing grade, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Her run still left a slight lingering sense of unease.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, wheeze*... I'm completely wiped out...
Even though I didn't push myself that hard...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd have a bit more stamina left
at the end. So this is 1,800 meters...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, surely it's because of a lack of training.
Fine then, in that case!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Even more furious!
Let us push ourselves to the limit.
The one who will win the decisive Shuka Sho is me!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Bwah-hah-hah-hah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All three reacted at the same time. Which meant...
I hadn't misheard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My laugh had turned weird again.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You've got to be kidding me. I haven't eaten a single thing!
Not the salsa, not the habanero pasta,
not even the Mapo Eggplant of the Dead!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And yet, why did it happen again?
Could it be fatigue from the race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I doubted it was anything serious,
I decided to have her examined just in case.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
They're making such a fuss.
Sending me for a checkup just because my laugh sounded a bit strained.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So, what happened, Doctor?
What's the reason?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
“Laughing too much? Too tired? Or maybe
a flake of red pepper was still left behind?”

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Ah, your raspy voice isn't
from eating spicy food, is it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well then, what's your reason?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: The reason is...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: It is epiglottic entrapment.
